Method of Attack: Spam campaign targeting Italian users by pretending to be the Italian Revenue Agency
Spam emails with malicious Word document attachment (VERDI.doc) containing embedded macros
Enabling macros downloads and executes ransomware executable
Changes desktop wallpaper with ransom instructions
Ransom note DECRYPT-FILES.txt demanding payment for decryption key
Attack Vector: Spam email with malicious Word document attachment containing macros
Indicators of Compromise: Spam email subject: "AGGIORNAMENTO: Attivita di contrasto all'evasione. Aggiornamento"
Malicious Word document attachment named VERDI.doc
Wallpaper changed to image with ransom instructions
